title: Cosmic Dog and Spirit
description: A vibrant surreal painting features a large green dog with a yellow collar in profile, gazing right. Overlapping the dog's body is a circular cosmic portal containing a stylized human face with closed eyes, surrounded by stars, nebulae, and swirling galaxy patterns against a background of flowing purple, teal, and yellow waves.
